name: The Shops at Sportsmen's Lodge
description: The Shops at Sportsmen's Lodge is a vibrant mixed-use destination in Studio City featuring boutique retailers, dining, and services on the historic site of the former Sportsmen's Lodge Hotel. This modern open-air shopping center blends seamlessly into the Studio City neighborhood, offering a curated selection of local and national tenants in a walkable, contemporary setting.
summary: A modern boutique shopping center in Studio City offering curated retail, dining, and services in an open-air setting on the site of the historic Sportsmen's Lodge.
